ownership_repair.cause: Shared generic business/store cleanup was callable without proving this module ownership; the previous static package is superseded
ownership_repair.contract: Before Store.prepare: refuse existing shared business/store/control receipts, native volumes, backup resources and Longhorn PVs. Freeze run/cluster/random token intent. Private Store lab proxy tags its FIRST and every subsequent store receipt write. Business journal includes same identity at first write and retains it. Cleanup validates all shared receipt owners and foreign control records before any mutation. Without business journal, only an owned intent plus an owned partial-store receipt allows store cleanup. Retire intent to a complete receipt after shared materials are absent. Repeated clean accepts only current retired receipt and absent shared scope and calls no store/business cleanup. Foreign business, foreign store, unrelated control receipt, orphan directory, missing owner or newly appeared shared state stops without mutation.
